verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere documents an official CLI, Wally, with concrete commands (`wally account whoami`, `wally account usage`), browser-based sign-in that hands a credential to the terminal, one-command integration with tools, and offline local model runs; a probe confirms official CLI releases on GitHub. Community hands-on reports of a separate RunAnywhere CLI (rcli) crashing and failing to install point to reliability concerns, but they do not contradict that the Wally CLI exists. Missing for 10: a full command reference, independent hands-on corroboration of the Wally CLI specifically, and evidence of stable installation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Check it with `wally account whoami`, and see what you have spent with `wally account usage`.
When a small model on your own machine is enough, the same CLI runs it, offline and without an account.
The browser opens, you approve the request, and the terminal receives its credential.
